QuestInfo.name: [Mount] The Lost Saddle
QuestInfo.0: I lost the #t1912000# that I received from #b#p2060005##k!  What should I do?  Hmmm... Maybe I should go see #p2060005#. I hope he's nice enough to give me another one!
QuestInfo.1:
#p2060005# says that making a #t1912000# for monster riding requires special ingredients.  He needs #b200#t4000171#, 200 #t4000030#, 200 #t4000055##k.  #p2060005# says he will also need #b5 million mesos#k for 'research purposes'.  I believe this is otherwise known as 'extortion'. He's probably a bit upset at me for losing the first one. Oh well, looks like I've got some work to do...


#i4000171##t4000171# #b#c4000171#/200#k
#i4000030##t4000030# #b#c4000030#/200#k
#i4000055##t4000055# #b#c4000055#/200#k
QuestInfo.2: I returned to #p2060005# with the proper materials and the 5 million meso extortion--I mean 'Research Fee'. In return for my efforts, I received #t1912000# from #p2060005#.  I should be able ride monsters again with this. I'll be sure not to lose it again!

0.0: 어라? 전에 몬스터 라이딩 스킬을 익히신 분 아니세요? 그런데 왜 몬스터는 안 타고... 여긴 어쩐 일이시죠? 네에? #t1912000#을 잃어버리셨다고요?
0.1: 이런! 몬스터와의 공존을 실현시킬 분이라고 생각해서 #t1912000#을 드렸는데, 그것을 잃어버리다니... 휴우. 하는 수 없죠. 다시 #b#t1912000##k을 만들어 드리도록 할게요.

yes.0: 하지만, 이번에는 #t1912000#을 만드는 재료를 모두 구해 오셔야 해요. 재료는 #b#t4000171# 200개, #t4000030# 200개, #t4000055# 200개#k에요. 많다고요? 물론 많지요. 몬스터의 거친 등에 얹힐 물건이니까요!
yes.1: 아, 이번에는 재료만으로는 안 돼요! #t1912000#을 만드는 동안 연구를 못 하게 되니, 그 만큼의 보상도 해 주셔야지요. 연구 지원금 #b500만 메소#k도 가죽과 함께 가져 오세요. 과하다고 하셔도 소용 없어요. 이 정도는 해야 다시는 #t1912000#을 안 잃어버리실 테니까요!

no.0: 싫으신가요? 그렇다면 하는 수 없죠. 당신께 몬스터 라이딩 스킬을 가르쳐 드린 것이 조금 후회되네요

0.0: Aren't you the one who learned the monster riding skill from me? Why didn't you get on the monster? Did you lose #t1912000#?
0.1: You're kidding, right? I gave you #t1912000# because I believe that humans and monsters can live in peace together. You lost it...Sigh. I know what to do. I'll make another #b#t1912000##k for you, but you'll have to do some work!

yes.0: You'll have to gather all the ingredients to make #t1912000#. They are 200 #b#t4000171#, 200#t4000030#, 200#t4000055##k. Sound like a lot? I'll admit the amount seems excessive, but if you want something of high quality, it takes more material. The one I gave you before was one of kind...
yes.1: Got everything? Excellent! However, I'll need one more thing from you...As I can't do my research while making #t1912000#, you'll have to compensate me for it. I believe #b5 million mesos#k for a replacement sounds reasonable. It may ease your mind to know that you will also help fund further research into human-monster relationships with your donation. Well, should I get started?

no.0: You don't want another one? Hmm, I had you pegged as someone who wanted to help spread the idea of monsters and humans living together, apparently I was wrong.

1.0: You have all the ingredients and the donation? Great! I'm ready to make #t1912000# for you right now then...let me cut the leather and paste it, and sew it....that's it All done!
1.1: Now, #b#t1912000##k is all done. I've made a few modifications to this one, it's a special #t1912000# to protect people from rough hairs of monster. One must be comfortable, after all...

yes.0: Try not to lose this one--they're hard to make, you know!

item.0: You haven't gathered all the ingredients. Remember, I'll need 200#b#t4000171#, 200#t4000030#, 200#t4000055##kl. In addition to that, #b5 million mesos#k. When you have everything, return and I'll make you a new one!
